<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="sanguine-werewolves" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Sanguine Werewolves</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sanguine_werewolf <nowiki>Sanguine werewolves</nowiki>]<nowiki> are a low level Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> mob found in </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Berylbrook <nowiki>Berylbrook</nowiki>]<nowiki>, located in Havenhythe. They are mainly killed for the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Havenhythe <nowiki>Havenhythe collection log</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 99 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required to access the Sunken Pyramid</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 1,877.5</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~850 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~575 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Sunken Pyramid)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~1.52m </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~1.08m </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Sunken Pyramid)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="desirable-drops"><ins><nowiki>Desirable drops</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Crimson_ichor <nowiki>Crimson ichor</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Forgotten_painting <nowiki>Forgotten painting piece (1-5)</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Sanguine werewolves can be fought in </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Berylbrook <nowiki>Berylbrook</nowiki>]<nowiki> or the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunken_Pyramid <nowiki>Sunken Pyramid</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Berylbrook</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/mx0A7JlRmi.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ If killing sanguine werewolves in </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Berylbrook <nowiki>Berylbrook</nowiki>]<nowiki>, use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as shown above.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While standing on the path, line yourself up with the blue fish on the clothesline then place the cannon 2 tiles north and then move back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You may have to get them unstuck from the clothesline for the first kill, thus allowing them to get pulled from the side by the cannon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Sunken Pyramid</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/lh39WYpTE1.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ If killing sanguine werewolves in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunken_Pyramid <nowiki>Sunken Pyramid</nowiki>]<nowiki>, use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• May instead use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1534426786048249907.png?v=1" alt="houseteleportfree" title="houseteleportfree" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and select Menaphos as your exit destination.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place 5 Sanguine Werewolves in the small room, and position yourself 7 tiles south of the northern statue.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-berylbrook-afk"><ins><nowiki>Method: Berylbrook AFK</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Before loading your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and starting the session, check the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will require extra sustain.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upkeeping either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555704881321353257.png?v=1" alt="superantisanguine" title="superantisanguine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555705025194623026.png?v=1" alt="extremeantisanguine" title="extremeantisanguine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required if using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555692252213547139.png?v=1" alt="havensilverhalberd2" title="havensilverhalberd2" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Also requires </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1487224784428335255.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismgloves" title="vampyrismgloves" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="vampscrim" title="vampscrim" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use armour perked with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1" alt="dev4" title="dev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavenge <nowiki>Scavenge</nowiki>]<nowiki> (legendary pet) to &quot;miscellaneous&quot; only.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/7e7e4454-406d-4530-8f30-4e9b9e89399e/7x4/?v=4dc4f75bb35eb060b6a368bbe5213e767ac4ac664642216fbca31bf256df00b5 <nowiki>Melee</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/93c16da465db62c4d4628b9ab92d956122f663162fa9808aecbc313ec7cd7d7b.webp" alt="Berylbrook AFK Melee Sanguine Werewolves" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ability-bars"><nowiki>Ability Bars</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/4N6N2iZDW1.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-sunken-pyramid-afk"><ins><nowiki>Method: Sunken Pyramid AFK</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Before starting the session, check the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Magic</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and autocast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofwen" title="scriptureofwen" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavenge <nowiki>Scavenge</nowiki>]<nowiki> (legendary pet) to &quot;miscellaneous&quot; only.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Melee</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required if using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1555692252213547139.png?v=1" alt="havensilverhalberd2" title="havensilverhalberd2" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Also requires a different form of prayer restoration </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="vampscrim" title="vampscrim" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use armour perked with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Scavenge <nowiki>Scavenge</nowiki>]<nowiki> (legendary pet) to &quot;miscellaneous&quot; only.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="presets-and-relics_1"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=cc655135-8162-4979-97f0-2bf81afe98aa <nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/958ac3bc718d0ac91329e3a7be942bdc7430d6b0275d7fe01b487cf82d4e659a.webp" alt="Sunken Pyramid AFK Magic Sanguine Werewolves" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/66b221e9-1f03-438a-ac94-6246ebd4777b/7x4/?v=57bc8e63fb1fe7c8cb01fdfa7d1cf28f3abfabbdf26d959f2d58d926125ab542 <nowiki>Necro</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/a6f00dd1d9aa8077a007df0a5eaa82191954dcd25886d89583b0ed9bdbc6c009.webp" alt="AFK Necro Sanguine Werewolves" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
